market_rationale: Inflation releases on October 14-16 dominate the one-week window. Elevated services prices, oil supply constraints and hawkish Fed minutes compete with weak payroll growth. Selected pullbacks merit reversal consideration, but higher yields provide a genuine reason for repricing rather than evidence of indiscriminate overreaction. Reported dispersion is high, although Ethereum's extreme observations make its magnitude unreliable. Quality scores are price-derived evidence, not independent fundamental confirmation.
portfolio_rationale: Oil has the strongest independent case for reversal because supply constraints contrast with substantial trailing underperformance. Semiconductors narrowly meet the reversal threshold on the combination of an unusually deep pullback, strong preceding relative performance and unexceptional selling volume. Technology and other quality pullbacks remain below the eligibility threshold because inflation and rates can explain their weakness. The deterministic rule therefore retains a benchmark slot rather than forcing a third eligible selection.
